import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
print(w.work_id.duplicated().sum(), w.year.isna().sum())
w=w[w.year.notna()&(w.n_passages>0)].copy()
w['rate']=w[c]/w.n_passages;w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
ap=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count');w['aprod']=ap
for v in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']: print(pd.crosstab(w[v],w.late))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','aprod','n_passages']].mean())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).rate.mean().unstack()
  return (g[1]-g[0]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w);print(e);print(g)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
for i in range(2000):
  s=w.groupby(['genre','late'],group_keys=False).apply(lambda x:x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)))
  bs.append(est(s)[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in w.date_confidence.unique(): print(dc, est(w[w.date_confidence==dc])[0])
for o in w.origin.unique(): print(o, est(w[w.origin==o])[0])
m=smf.wls('rate~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions+1)+np.log(aprod)',w,weights=w.n_passages).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
print(w.groupby('decade').rate.agg(['mean','count']))
